{"content":"# Cannot run the checks on Python 3, and the license leaves out the bundled option parser

## What happens now

The test helper at `tests/conftest.py` starts by loading `cStringIO`, a module that exists only in Python 2. On Python 3 that load fails, so the whole check run stops before a single check is reported. The same file also asks whether typed input is `unicode`, a name Python 3 does not have, and it walks the environment dictionary with `iteritems`, a method Python 3 does not have. Nothing was verified on Python 3.

## What should happen

I want to be able to run the project's own checks on Python 3 as well as on Python 2 and see real pass or fail results for the commands, groups, options, numbers, flags and files.

## About this project

Click is a Python library for writing command line programs. You describe a command and its options in plain Python and get help text, error messages and exit codes without writing any of that yourself.
